h:
V2.0 - 角色替换

在此版本 2 中，我从版本 1 中减少了一些步骤，仅将图像中的人替换为 LoRA 人。任何尝试过版本 1 的人都会知道这是那里工作的子步骤之一。

这也使得它比版本 1 更简单且更易于使用。

V1.0 - 多人LoRA人

此工作流程将帮助您将不同的 LoRA 人员管理到一个图像中。您可以创建 1 人至 3 人的图像。我认为可以做更多的事情，但需要更多的 GPU 能力。所以我觉得3个人就够了。尝试一下这个工作流程，我希望你喜欢它。

技巧 -> 使用关键字，例如，

  • 左、右中间人

  • 一、二、三、人

  • 降噪 0.6 保持姿势不变是一个很好的水平，但如果将其增加到 1，您将得到 LoRA 人的新姿势，增加脸部的相似度，但有时可能会显示扭曲的结果。

  • 通常情况下，我已经为你准备好了所有的马克计算。但是，如果您想更改为仅修复脸部或仅修复一半身体，则需要自行重新计算Mark。

o.en:
V2.0 - Character Replace

In this version 2, I have reduced some steps from version 1 to just replace the person from the image with LoRA person. Anyone who has tried version 1 will know that this is one of the sub-steps of the work there.

This also makes it much less complicated and easier to use than version 1.

V1.0 - Multi LoRA Person

This workflows It will help you to manage different LoRA persons into one image. You can create images from 1 person up to 3 persons. I think it is possible to do more but it will require more GPU power. so I think 3 persons is just fine. Try this workflow, I hope you like it.

Trick -> use keyword like,

  • left, right center person

  • one, second, third, person

  • denoise 0.6 It's a good level to keep the pose the same, but if you increase it to 1 you will get a new pose of your LoRA person that increases the likeness of the face, but sometimes it may show distorted results.

  • Normally, I have already prepared all the Mark calculations for you. However, if you want to change it to fix only the face or only half of the body, you will need to recalculate the Mark agian by yourself.
